[[File:Sigmoid function.png|thumbnail|]]
The '''sigmoid function''' is a bounded, differentiable, and real-valued [[special function]], commonly used as an [[activation function]] in [[artificial neural network (ANN)|artificial neural networks (ANN)]].

It is the inverse of the [[logit function]].

== Definition ==

$$
\sigma:\mathbb{R}\to(0,1)\\
\sigma(x)=\frac{1}{1+e^{-x}}.
$$

== Properties ==

=== Limits ===

The sigmoid is strictly increasing, with limits

$$
\lim_{x\to-\infty}\sigma(x)=0,
\qquad
\lim_{x\to+\infty}\sigma(x)=1.
$$

=== Symmetry ===

$$
\sigma(-x)=1-\sigma(x).
$$

=== Derivative ===

$$
\dot{\sigma}(x)=\sigma(x)\bigl(1-\sigma(x)\bigr).
$$
